def replay(X, y, l0, l2, M, cert):
    (n, p) = X.shape
    G = X.T @ X
    w = np.asarray(cert['weights'])
    err = X @ w - y
    obj = 0.5 * (err @ err + l2 * (w @ w)) + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08)
    assert max(abs(w)) <= M and abs(obj - cert['objective']) < 1e-09
    leaves = cert['subcube_leaves']
    assert 1 <= len(leaves) <= 2048
    bits = 1 << np.arange(p)
    covers = np.zeros(1 << p, dtype=np.uint8)
    seen_diag = {}
    replay_slack = 0.0
    for leaf in leaves:
        for key in ('fixed_zero', 'fixed_active'):
            assert len(leaf[key]) == p and all((type(v) is bool for v in leaf[key]))
        (z, a) = (np.array(leaf[key]) for key in ('fixed_zero', 'fixed_active'))
        assert not (z & a).any()
        free = ~(a | z)
        free_bits = bits[free]
        mask = np.array([sum(bits[a])])
        for b in free_bits:
            mask = np.r_[mask, mask + b]
        assert not covers[mask].any()
        covers[mask] = 1
        dl = tuple(leaf['minorant_diagonal'])
        d = np.array(dl)
        c = np.array(leaf['minorant_center'])
        assert c.shape == d.shape == (p,)
        if dl not in seen_diag:
            assert np.min(d) >= 0 and np.linalg.eigvalsh(G - np.diag(d))[0] >= -1e-09
            seen_diag[dl] = True
        r = y - X @ c
        g = X.T @ r
        t = np.abs(g + d * c)
        q = d + l2
        b = np.minimum(M, np.divide(t, q, out=np.full(p, M), where=q > 0))
        on = l0 - b * (t - q * b / 2)
        replay = 0.5 * (r @ r + d * c @ c) + g @ c + on[a].sum() + np.minimum(on[free], 0).sum()
        assert leaf['lb'] <= replay + 1e-08, (leaf['lb'], replay)
        replay_slack = max(replay_slack, replay - leaf['lb'])
    assert covers.all()
    L = min((v['lb'] for v in leaves))
    assert L == cert['certified_lower_bound'] and 0 <= obj - L <= 1e-05
    return (len(leaves), obj - L, replay_slack)

def make(seed, p, corr, bound):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n = 850
    ncal = 630
    ns = n - ncal
    group = np.tile(np.arange(5), 170)
    rng.shuffle(group)
    s = np.array([rng.choice(3, p=np.roll([0.65, 0.25, 0.1], int(g) % 3)) for g in group])
    z = rng.normal(size=(n, 8)) + 0.25 * s[:, None]
    phase = rng.uniform(-2.9, 2.9, size=(n, 2))
    ref = np.exp(1j * rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, size=(n, 2)))
    offset = np.array([2, -1, 3, -2, 0.4])[group, None]
    gain = np.array([0.8, 1.1, 1.5, 2.1, 0.7])[group, None]
    raw = z * gain + offset
    ctrl = rng.normal(size=(n, 18)) * gain + offset
    raw[rng.random(raw.shape) < 0.025] = np.nan
    ctrl[rng.random(ctrl.shape) < 0.05] = np.nan
    theta = rng.normal(size=13)
    H = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), s == 1, s == 2, z, phase])
    y = H @ theta + 0.055 * rng.normal(size=n)
    bad = rng.choice(ncal, int(0.12 * ncal), replace=False)
    y[bad] += np.clip(2 * rng.standard_cauchy(len(bad)), -11, 11)
    X = (np.sqrt(1 - corr) * rng.normal(size=(ns, p)) + np.sqrt(corr) * rng.normal(size=(ns, 1))) / np.sqrt(ns)
    w = np.zeros(p)
    w[[1, 3, 6, 8, 11]] = [0.6, -0.7, 1.2, -1.1, 0.87] if bound else [0.9, -1.5, 1.7, -1.5, 1.15]
    y[ncal:] += X @ w
    return (dict(panel=dict(center_id=group, stratum=s, X_panel_raw=raw, controls=ctrl), interferometry=dict(signal_phasor=ref * np.exp(1j * phase), ref_phasor=ref), y_assay_raw=y, calibration_indices=np.arange(ncal), stage3_indices=np.arange(ncal, n), X_cand=X, lam0=0.09, lam2=0.08, M=0.88 if bound else 2.0), z, theta)
